verdict.rationale: Firstbase's own registered-agent page says it will legally change your registered agent in your incorporation state after you fill out company details, so it handles the change-of-agent filing for switchers. It does not document the specific state forms or change fees, and its commitment only covers the incorporation state. missing for 10: per-state documentation of change-of-agent forms and fees, explicit coverage of agent changes in foreign-qualified states, independent or hands-on corroboration of the switching process.

support.subject: As a founder switching providers, the new provider prepares or files the change-of-agent paperwork and documents each state's form and fee

citations.quote: Fill out some details about your company. We'll legally change your registered agent in your incorporation state.
